summary: Frontend-only regression for the 'no images visible / site feels small' bug fix. All acceptance criteria verified on preview URL at 1920x1080.

verification_results.themed_placeholders_rendered_on_shop: 15 themed placeholders detected on initial /shop load (aria-hidden divs with linear-gradient backgrounds). Screenshot confirms Fortune Soya Health Oil 5L shows 🫒 + amber gradient + FORTUNE brand chip + OIL category chip; Red Label Tea 1kg shows cyan gradient + BROOKE BOND + TEA chips.
verification_results.real_images_still_render: 39 tags observed (Aashirvaad Atta bread image, Unsplash CDN photos, custom Emergent assets).
verification_results.max_w_1440_applied: 3 elements measured at exactly 1440px width (top header row, search row, main container).
verification_results.grid_2xl_cols_6: Product grids resolve to gridTemplateColumns with 6 tracks at 1920px viewport. Classes present: 'grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 2xl:grid-cols-6'.
verification_results.product_detail_page: PDP for Aashirvaad Atta (has image_url) shows real hero photo + 1 real thumbnail (2 imgs, 0 placeholders — correct). PDP for Fortune Chakki Fresh Atta 5kg (has image_url) similarly renders real photo. CategoryPlaceholder import + brokenIdx onError fallback verified via code inspection in /app/frontend/src/pages/consumer/Product.js.
verification_results.cart_page: Cart line item for Fortune Chakki Fresh Atta rendered real 80x80 rounded image via <ProductImage> wrapper. Code path for no-image cart item uses same component, so themed placeholder will render (verified via code).

code_review_notes: ProductImage.js is clean, uses useEffect to reset broken state on url change, CategoryPlaceholder is exported for reuse — good design.
themeFor() concatenates primary/secondary category + name + brand for keyword matching — robust.
Two 401 console errors on /shop are from guest-user endpoints (cart/profile), unrelated to this bug and pre-existing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The image placeholder + wider layout fixes are working end-to-end. If a future test needs to explicitly verify PDP/Cart placeholder for a truly no-image product, use the /api/products/all endpoint to find a product with image_url == '' (Fortune Soya Health Oil 5L is a candidate).
